articles.title: India's factory output grows 7.3% in June, fastest pace in nearly two years
articles.original_title: India's factory output grows 7.3% in June, fastest pace in nearly two years
articles.description: India's industrial production surged 7.3% in June, marking its fastest growth in nearly two years. Manufacturing and electricity generation showed a sharp acceleration, exceeding economists' expectations. This strong performance suggests robust domestic economic growth despite global uncertainties. Capital goods, primary goods, and intermediate goods were key contributors to this expansion. Other sectors like mining and water supply also registered positive growth.
